_comment: Source configuration for the Nous adapter. Copy this file to `integral.config.json` (sibling) to override the default. The Vite plugin reads `integral.config.json` at startup; if absent, it falls back to a single 'inference-sim' source pointing at ~/Documents/Projects/inference-sim. Add multiple Nous workspaces by adding entries to the `sources` array. v0.1 only supports `kind: "nous"`; coral/feature/paper kinds land in v0.2 alongside their adapters.
